apply.intro: We only ask what we need for this item and this amount. You’ll see our answer as soon as you’ve replied.

apply.cannotQuote: This term and down payment can’t be priced. Go back to the item and choose again.
apply.decision.incomplete: Answer the questions and you’ll see our answer here straight away.
apply.decision.approved: Yes! You can lease this item.
apply.decision.rejected: Sorry, we can’t offer you this lease.
apply.decision.manual_review: A person will check your application.
apply.decision.rejectedText: This isn’t a judgement of you, only of our rules. Here’s why:
apply.decision.manualReviewText: We can’t decide this automatically. Send your application and someone from our team will get back to you.
apply.reason.financed_limits: The amount to finance must be between {min} and {max}, and this one isn’t.
apply.reason.min_age: You need to be at least 18 to sign a lease. A parent or guardian could lease it in their name instead.

apply.reason.affordability: The monthly price would be more than 30 % of your monthly net income. A cheaper item, a longer term or a down payment would bring it down.
apply.reason.business_id: The business ID doesn’t add up: its last digit (the check digit) doesn’t match. Please check it.

apply.reason.signatory_authorization: You can’t sign for the company, so we’ll ask the person who can.
apply.error.invalid_business_id: This business ID isn’t valid. The format is 1234567-8, and the last digit is a check digit.
apply.error.under_age: You need to be at least 18.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.vatChange: From invoice {number} ({date}) VAT will be {to} % instead of {from} %. Your rent excl. VAT stays {net}, because it is locked; only the VAT part changes, so the total goes from {before} to {after}.
invoices.rules: Each month’s rent is billed at the start of that month, counted from the start date (a lease from 31 January is due on 28 or 29 February). VAT is the rate on the invoice date, rounded once to the cent. The rents excl. VAT add up exactly to the contract total.

pay.demoText: No money moves, and we don’t ask for bank or card details. Taking real payments safely (protecting bank details, preventing fraud, following payment regulations) is outside the scope of this app, and we have no way to safeguard that data. Pressing Pay only marks the invoice as paid.

footer.note: Lease Loop is a hackathon demo: the data is synthetic and no real money or contracts are involved.
admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: A control room for demonstrations, on the app’s date ({date}): totals, VAT changes, every contract and the audit log.
admin.items: Items: {available} available · {reserved} leased or reserved · {returned} returned.
admin.staffOnly: Changing VAT needs “Lease Loop staff” in “Acting as”. This demo has no real login, so anyone can switch.
admin.vat.title: VAT rates
admin.vat.rules: A change applies from its date until the next one, on every invoice, quote and contract. It must start after the app’s date, because tax already charged is not rewritten: time-travel back first to add one earlier. Changes are stored in the database; data/vat-rates.json is never edited, and npm run db:reset brings the original rates back.
admin.vat.errorPast: A VAT change must start after the app’s date.
admin.vat.errorRate: The rate must be between 0 and 100 %, with at most two decimals.
admin.vat.errorInForce: This VAT change has already started, so it can’t be removed.
admin.vat.errorGeneric: That didn’t work. Please try again.
admin.auditNote: Every change (applications, signatures, returns, payments, VAT) is written here in the same transaction as the change itself.
